summary: Outlines the requirements and challenges of Internet of Things (IoT) edge computing. Some IoT applications cannot be served well by centralized cloud systems because of time sensitivity, data volume, connectivity cost, intermittent service, privacy, and security. It presents a general model of IoT edge functions. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a smart sensor can't wait to ask a faraway computer for answers. This explains why thinking should happen nearby, and what problems that creates.
